00:00:00:00 - 00:00:03:22
YouTube has over 500 hours of video uploaded every minute.
00:00:04:07 - 00:00:07:06
Somewhere in there, a creator just featured your product
00:00:07:06 - 00:00:11:03

and by the time you find it manually, it might already have 50,000 views.

00:00:11:13 - 00:00:15:00
That review could be glowing - and you missed the window to share it,
00:00:15:09 - 00:00:18:03
amplify it, or reach out to that creator.
00:00:18:03 - 00:00:21:23
Or it could be critical - and it's already shaping how thousands of people
00:00:21:23 - 00:00:24:20
think about your brand, while you're still in the dark.
00:00:24:20 - 00:00:26:02
Today I'm going to show you
00:00:26:02 - 00:00:29:23
how to use YouTube Scraper from Apify to build a fully automated brand
00:00:29:23 - 00:00:32:23
monitoring system that catches every mention,
00:00:32:23 - 00:00:36:06
surfaces influencer opportunities, and feeds your data
00:00:36:06 - 00:00:38:01
wherever you need it.
